messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 2D mobile/tablet game about an aircraft carrier and its five escorts defending against waves of ships, aircraft, submarines, and rival carrier groups.

## Requirements
- Deliver a playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- Support phone/tablet touch controls and responsive layouts.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained HTML Canvas game with five waves, WASD/arrow movement, auto-targeting fire, an Aegis pulse, and touch controls.
- Used custom-drawn ocean, ships, projectiles, and effects; no external assets or dependencies.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the game in `index.html`, including title, pause, win/loss states, HUD, enemy types, combat, and responsive controls.
- Verified JavaScript syntax with `node --check`.
- Opened the game in Playwright, deployed the fleet, confirmed wave/contact HUD updates, and captured desktop and mobile JPEGs.
- Confirmed at 390×844 mobile viewport: touch controls display and page height fits viewport.

### Active
- None.

### Blocked
- None.

## Next Move
1. Optionally do a final quick code review and report the completed game and assumptions to the user.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/bluewater.jpg`: Title-screen screenshot.
- `screenshots/bluewater-play.jpg`: Gameplay screenshot.
- `screenshots/bluewater-mobile.jpg`: Mobile viewport screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local Python HTTP server was started on port 3002 for browser checks.
- Playwright initially logged a favicon 404; no game runtime errors were observed.
- Browser check showed game starts successfully; screenshot checks were performed.

content.text:
Implemented **Bluewater — Fleet Defender** in `index.html` as a playable, dependency-free 2D game.

- Defend the carrier and five escorts through five escalating waves of ships, aircraft, submarines, and rival carrier groups.
- Includes auto-targeting fire, an Aegis pulse, hull and escort status, scoring, pause, and win/loss screens.
- Supports keyboard and touch controls with a responsive phone/tablet layout.
- Verified JavaScript syntax and checked the game in a browser, including the mobile layout at 390×844.

Assumption: the game uses a top-down arcade style with custom-drawn graphics. Check screenshots are saved at `screenshots/bluewater.jpg`, `screenshots/bluewater-play.jpg`, and `screenshots/bluewater-mobile.jpg`.
